openwrt_git_ar71xx.titel: ar71xx: add kernel support for the TL-WDR3500 board
openwrt_git_ar71xx.text: WDR3500 is similar to WDR3600 except it doesn't have gigabit ethernet, and has only 1 USB port. Pending issues: Leds are not working at all (except power and wlan_5g); LAN switch ethernet ports are reversed with respect to case label. [LAN1] -> eth0.4, [LAN2] -> eth0.3, [LAN3] -> eth0.2, [LAN4] -> eth0.1

fcc.grant_notes_titel_2012: N600 Wireless Dual Band Gigabit Router
fcc.grant_comments: Power Output listed is conducted. Device is an 802.11n device in a 2x2 Spatial Multiplexing MIMO configuration. Separation distance 20 cm.
